name: Jelly Slice

features.name: Slicer
features.description: Cuts symbols into 2–4 pieces to multiply the ways.

features.name: Up to 1,204 ways
features.description: The ways count changes with every slice.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Bonus rounds with more frequent Slicers.

review:
A sweet factory on a 5x4 ways grid, built around the Slicer. Before the drop, a reel can get a Slicer that cuts every symbol passing through into two, three or four pieces – pushing the ways up to 1,204.

More pieces means more ways for matches to connect. It's rated 3/5, so it plays steadier than a lot of Hacksaw, with a 10,000x max in every mode. Jenny and Jinny's candy factory looks bright and cheerful.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
